name: Entitlement Quality Monitor
tagline: Stop overpaying for software your people don't use.
description: Connects to your identity provider, flags entitlement drift in real time, and surfaces remediation actions. Built on FastAPI and Appian. Production-tested for SaaS license recovery.

name: Resiliency Testing Orchestrator
tagline: Run a BCP test without calling a meeting.
description: OOR-first business continuity simulator. Define your recovery scope, run a scenario, and get a structured gap report — no consultant required. FastAPI backend with Streamlit UI.

name: YouTube Channel Analytics Monitor
tagline: A clear, subscriber-ready view of channel performance.
description: A public demonstration of the YouTube channel analytics monitors we can build for subscribers to our consulting services. It uses fully synthetic channel data to showcase growth, qualifying watch hours, organic momentum, promotion planning, content intelligence, and format comparisons — without connecting a live account.

name: CMDB Risk Dashboard
tagline: Know which data center outage will actually hurt before it happens.
description: Live risk assessment reporting dashboard for data center CMDB assets. Scores infrastructure by exposure, criticality, and control gaps, then ranks assets so risk and ops teams can prioritize remediation instead of reacting to the next outage. Reads live from a deployed FastAPI backend.

name: Service Risk & Availability Dashboard
tagline: See every service a third party touches — and every gap in it.
description: Bottom-up view of the services a third party provides across data center clients, mapped to the gaps in each one. Surfaces and ranks remediation priorities so risk teams can act on the weakest links first instead of reviewing services in isolation.

name: Knowledge Evolution Layer
tagline: Track what your organization knows — before the gap becomes a liability.
description: Embeddings-based drift detection that surfaces how institutional knowledge diverges from team behavior over time. Routes queries across local and cloud LLMs based on sensitivity.

name: M-VARA — My Virtual Accountant Research Assistant
tagline: Turn a Rocket Money export into answers you can act on.
description: Explore how M-VARA surfaces spending shifts, recurring drains, transaction evidence, and cash-runway questions from a pseudonymized Rocket Money dataset—without exposing private account details.

name: PBL Evaluator
tagline: Score the plain business language behind every entitlement.
description: Lets managers evaluate the quality of an entitlement's plain business language and RBAC design before it ships, catching vague remediation steps and inconsistent access rules before they become audit findings.

name: FlightWatch Virtual Travel Agent
tagline: See the route combination worth watching—not just another fare list.
description: Guided product simulator showing how FlightWatch turns a flexible Europe brief into cabin-aware, open-jaw flight recommendations and an actionable fare email. Uses fixed fictional sample data, makes no live API calls, and collects no personal data.

name: Job Search Dashboard
tagline: Turn job-application emails into a clear status view.
description: Interactive demonstration of a local-first job search tracker. Explore 50 recent application records by company, role, date, and status. The retail product guides job seekers through building their own private local dashboard with Codex or Claude.

name: Parliamo in Italia
tagline: Practice the Italian travel phrases you'll actually need.
description: Italian-first question and anticipated-response flash cards with spoken audio, dictionary-referenced IPA, English flip sides, progress tracking, and browser-local custom phrases. Public and ready to use without an account or password.

name: Travel Monitor Tool (TMT)
tagline: Your itinerary, alerts, and trip costs - without another subscription.
description: Tired of paying for subscriptions like TripIt? Build your own travel monitor with Claude Code or Codex, then modify features such as tracking the total cost of a trip as you book it and while you travel. Download the free guide and make the tool your own.

name: PrestoVideo
tagline: Review a professionally produced social video before you pay.
description: A live, human-in-the-loop social-video ordering and fulfillment tool created with GPT-supported product design and software development. Choose a 30- or 60-second video, narration voice, and visual style; submit a brief; review the finished video; and pay only if you want it.

name: PrestoVideo Jira Project Record
tagline: See how human direction and Codex-supported development became a working service.
description: This public Jira project was created from the exported tasks and human–Codex dialogue used to build the PrestoVideo service application. It distinguishes human decisions and approvals from Codex-supported implementation, and presents an estimated comparison of the time and cost that equivalent human-only development may have required. Estimates are illustrative, not an audited invoice.

name: ChatGPT Browser-Driven Jira Build
tagline: Watch a human direct ChatGPT as it builds a Jira dashboard through Chrome.
description: A human provides the objective, prompts, and approvals while ChatGPT uses browser-control capabilities through Chrome to operate Jira’s visible interface. This demonstration shows the collaboration creating and modifying a dashboard, arranging its layout, and adding or configuring Jira gadgets while the human observes and directs the work.
